summary: The FBI crime-database breach probe and the USDA cyber incident are still unexplained, and no official source links them. Chip stocks fell Tuesday and Bitcoin is near 60,000 dollars, with no trading halts found. Smaller outages, like TikTok, look separate.

events.title: FBI probes suspected breach of its national crime database
events.impact: Police use NCIC to check warrants, stolen vehicles and missing people. It holds over 18 million records. It is unclear if data was copied, changed or made unavailable. I found no new FBI update.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. The FBI has not publicly confirmed details. No attacker is named. Press notes no sign it is tied to the earlier ShinyHunters FBI breach.

events.title: USDA cyber incident hit farm payment and loan systems
events.impact: Farm loan, payment and conservation systems were shut down. USDA expected most to return by the weekend. As of Nov 24, USDA had not said whether all systems are fully restored.
events.stated_cause: A USDA under secretary said systems were shut down over a cyber threat and no personal data was lost. No attacker is named and USDA has given few details.

events.title: Tanker attacks continue near Strait of Hormuz
events.impact: Iran says three tankers hit mines despite US escort. The UK maritime office says three ships were hit by unknown projectiles Monday, and all kept sailing. Brent oil is about 89 to 90 dollars, near three-month lows.
events.stated_cause: Iran says mines. The UK office says unidentified projectiles. Nobody has claimed those hits. Iranian claims are not independently verified.

events.title: US tech stocks fall Tuesday after Monday's big rebound
events.impact: Price check at close: S&P 500 7,201.09 (-0.50%), Nasdaq 23,733.54 (-1.48%), Dow 50,018.70 (+0.85%). Chip index fell about 7.9%. Nvidia fell 5.9%. No halts found.
events.stated_cause: Reuters cites AI spending doubts, the Nvidia CEO news and worry about new tariffs. No technical fault or cyber attack is reported.

events.title: Bitcoin near 60K USD, down about 2% on the day and 6-7% on the week
events.impact: Price check: Coinbase 59,757 (-2.3%); CoinGecko 59,995 (-2.2%); Bitget 60,066 (-2%). About 25% lower than a month ago. No exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. Reports point to ETF selling, forced liquidations and Fed worries.

events.title: TikTok problems reported for about an hour Tuesday night
events.impact: One report cites about 25,000 US complaints on Downdetector. Users had trouble loading videos and posting. It appears to have eased after about an hour.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. TikTok has not given a cause in what I found. Only one outlet reported it, so this is unconfirmed.

events.title: Cloudflare status page shows partial outage on Sites and Services
events.impact: Cloudflare's own status feed lists Sites and Services as a partial outage, last changed at 00:12 UTC today. I found no wire report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare gave no cause in the data I saw.

events.title: CISA adds more actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Nov 23: MONAI Label and N-able Mail Assure. Nov 24: Idunno AntiCsrf, Drupal Core and Optimizely Web Experimentation. These are routine notices, not an emergency directive.
events.stated_cause: CISA cites active exploitation. It names no attacker and does not tie the flaws to the USDA or FBI incidents.

events.title: FAA ground stop at San Francisco airport for wind
events.impact: The FAA feed at 02:14 UTC lists an SFO ground stop until 7 pm PST. It also shows a Las Vegas delay program averaging 31 minutes, reason listed as other.
events.stated_cause: The FAA lists wind for SFO. No equipment failure or cyber attack is listed.

events.title: Spotify login problems for many users
events.impact: More than 15,000 users reported problems, mostly logging in. Reports fell to a few hundred within about an hour or two.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Spotify said it was checking the issue and later said things looked better. No official source reports a cyber attack.

events.title: Delta computer outage delayed flights; crews used manual math
events.impact: About 1,654 of 5,000 Delta flights were delayed Sunday. Crews used manual workarounds until automation returned.
events.stated_cause: Delta blamed its weight and balance system. The FAA said the delays were not related to air traffic control systems. No official source reports a cyber attack.

connection_assessment.reasoning: The FBI database probe and the USDA incident both have unknown causes, and no one has named an attacker for either. Delta blamed its own weight system, SFO is wind, and the stock and Bitcoin drops are tied to AI spending and Fed worries. No official source links any of these.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same company or attacker, or several big systems failing at the same moment, would make me think they are connected.

alert.reason: No confirmed sign of a link between incidents, no halts or major system failures in the last 2 hours.

prep_note: No action is needed for most people. If you use USDA farm programs, check with your local office before relying on payment dates. Keep some cash and a second way to reach key services. Check official sources for updates.
